content:
Updating beneficiary details does not recall a sent payment and does not credit a pending refund. The existing bank instruction remains attached to the existing payment.

Each original transfer retains its own payment status and settlement outcome. A new quote binds the beneficiary version current at quotation; execution requires that version and the corresponding approved request.

An unchanged principal does not make an old approval valid for a new bank version. Approval remains bound to the quoted bank version.
